description: This Java class defines a REST API resource for managing calendars associated with different entity types (such as centers, clients, groups, loans, savings) within a financial application. It provides endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting calendars, including handling calendar templates and recurring dates.

classes.name: CalendarsApiResource
classes.description: A REST API resource class for managing calendars linked to various financial entities, enabling CRUD operations and additional functionalities like templating and recurring date generation.

methods.name: retrieveCalendar
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific calendar by its ID, including generated recurring dates and next ten recurrence dates.

methods.name: retrieveCalendarsByEntity
methods.description: Retrieves a list of calendars associated with a specific entity type and ID, with optional association parameters and calendar type filtering.

methods.name: retrieveNewCalendarDetails
methods.description: Provides default or template details for creating a new calendar for a given entity.

methods.name: createCalendar
methods.description: Creates a new calendar for a specified entity using provided calendar request data.

methods.name: updateCalendar
methods.description: Updates an existing calendar identified by calendar ID with the provided JSON request body.

methods.name: deleteCalendar
methods.description: Deletes a calendar specified by its ID for a given entity.

methods.name: handleTemplate
methods.description: Enriches a CalendarData object with various options for entity type, calendar type, recurrence, and remind options, used when rendering templates.

methods.name: getResourceDetails
methods.description: Builds a CommandWrapper object representing resource-specific details based on the entity type and ID, used when creating resource commands.
